info.title: GitLab
info.description: Connect to GitLab (SaaS gitlab.com or a self-managed instance) to manage projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines, and comments.

get.description: Gets the profile of the authenticated user.
Lists projects that the authenticated user can access.

parameters.name: membership
parameters.description: Limit to projects the current user is a member of.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Return projects matching the search term.

get.description: Gets a single project by numeric ID or URL-encoded path (group/project).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Return issues in the given state.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search issues by title and description.

post.description: Creates a new issue in a project.

get.description: Gets a single project issue by its internal ID (IID).

post.description: Adds a note (comment) to a project issue.

get.description: Lists merge requests for a project.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Return merge requests in the given state.

post.description: Creates a merge request in a project.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Filter pipelines by branch or tag name.

post.description: Creates (triggers) a new pipeline for a given branch or tag.

get.description: Lists the webhooks configured on a project.

delete.description: Deletes a project webhook by its ID. Use this to clean up hooks manually if needed.

ProjectId.name: id
ProjectId.description: The project numeric ID or URL-encoded path (for example, my-group/my-project).

IssueIid.name: issue_iid
IssueIid.description: The internal ID (IID) of the issue within the project.

HookId.name: hook_id
HookId.description: The ID of the project webhook.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Number of items to return per page (max 100).

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number of results to return.

iid.description: Internal issue ID within the project.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label names (replaces existing).

iid.description: Internal merge request ID within the project.

remove_source_branch.description: Remove the source branch when merged.

iid.description: Internal pipeline ID within the project.

ref.description: Branch or tag the pipeline runs on.
The branch or tag to run the pipeline on.

url.description: Callback URL the hook posts to.

issues_events.description: Whether the hook fires on issue events.

push_events.description: Whether the hook fires on push events.

merge_requests_events.description: Whether the hook fires on merge request events.

pipeline_events.description: Whether the hook fires on pipeline events.

project.description: The project the event belongs to.

object_attributes.description: The issue that triggered the event.

iid.description: Internal issue ID within the project.

action.description: The action that occurred (open, update, close, reopen).

EventProject.description: The project the event belongs to.
